{"thought": "依語意層定義，客單價 = 有效訂單（status 1,2,3）商品金額總和（數量×單價，除以 100 換成元，不扣退款）÷ 不重複訂單張數，期間以台北時間判斷，通路限定 web。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"query": "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS valid_orders, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price_cents)/100.0, 2) AS item_amount_twd, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price_cents)/100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS aov FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (1,2,3) AND o.channel = 'web' AND strftime('%Y', datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours')) = '2025'"}}
